title: Subnautica Wakemakers
description: replaces Prismarine Crystals to the wakemakers from Subnautica 2
body:
![wakemakers ingame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87c12579b2b4e25381cab7cf1f2fd3cb38344a7f_0.webp)

## this texture replaces Prismarine Crystals to the wakemaker from Subnautica 2
## the model has animated textures too!
## you can also make it FUNCTIONAL by using this command below:


**(this command needs to be ran in a command block in order to get the wakemakers)**

give @a prismarine_crystals[​custom_name=[{"text":"The Wakemaker","italic":false,"color":"aqua"}],lore=[[{"text":"Wakemakers","bold":true,"italic":false,"color":"white"},{"text":" greatly increase ","italic":false,"color":"white"}],[{"text":"the ","italic":false,"color":"white"},{"text":"swimming speed","italic":false,"color":"dark_aqua"},{"text":" of the user ","italic":false,"color":"white"}],[{"text":"when held.","italic":false,"color":"white"}]],rarity=rare,attribute_modifiers=[{type:water_movement_efficiency,amount:1,slot:hand,operation:add_multiplied_total,id:"1780931419502"},{type:water_movement_efficiency,amount:1,slot:hand,operation:add_value,id:"1780931419503"},{type:water_movement_efficiency,amount:1,slot:hand,operation:add_multiplied_base,id:"1780931419504"},{type:water_movement_efficiency,amount:1,slot:hand,operation:add_value,id:"1780931419505"}],tooltip_display={hidden_components:[​attribute_modifiers]}]
